D: A determined 14-year-old hires a hard-drinking marshal to track down her father's killer.
P: Serve the cornbread when Rooster and LaBoeuf start shooting corn dodgers out of the air.
S: Fried cornmeal cakes made with bacon fat, eaten warm with butter
Fine cornmeal, salt and bacon fat mixed with boiling water, shaped into small oval cakes, fried in a cast iron pan until crisp, eaten warm with butter.
Flaky buttermilk biscuits with butter and golden syrup
Buttermilk biscuits baked at 220C for 12 minutes, split and served with butter and sorghum or golden syrup.
LaBoeuf's ham and cheddar hand pies

Flaky saddlebag pies of smoked ham, sharp cheddar and grainy mustard, baked golden, with pickled onions and a tangy apple relish. Cut 2 sheets of shortcrust pastry into 8 rounds. Mix 200g diced smoked ham, 150g grated sharp cheddar, 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and chopped parsley. Spoon onto half of each round, fold over and crimp with a fork. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 22 minutes until golden. Serve warm with pickled onions and apple relish.
M: Beef chuck, onion, carrots and potatoes cooked slowly until thick
Beef chuck browned in a camp oven, onion, carrot and potato added with stock and thyme, the lid on, cooked over low coals or at 160C for 3 hours until thick.
the boarding house table in Fort Smith

Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, fried crisp in cast iron, with honey drizzle, warm biscuits and a vinegar slaw. Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces in 400ml buttermilk, 1 tbsp hot sauce and 2 tsp salt overnight. Dredge in 250g plain flour mixed with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, salt and pepper. Shallow fry in 3cm oil at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked to 75C. Toss shredded cabbage with cider vinegar, sugar and salt. Serve with honey drizzled over and warm biscuits.
W: Chewy ginger and cinnamon molasses cookies rolled in sugar
Soft, chewy molasses spice cookies rolled in sugar, the kind you'd carry in a saddlebag.
K: Bourbon, honey, lemon and hot water with cinnamon and cloves

Bourbon stirred with honey, lemon and hot water, a cinnamon stick and clove-studded lemon in a tin cup. Hot apple and honey for Mattie. Put 1 tbsp honey and the juice of a quarter lemon in each of 4 tin cups or mugs. Add 45ml bourbon to each, top with 150ml just-boiled water and stir. Drop in a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with 3 cloves. Make Mattie's version with hot apple juice in place of the bourbon and water.

s.note: Fried cornmeal cakes made with bacon fat, eaten warm with butter
s.how: Fry 100g bacon for its fat and keep the fat. Mix 200g cornmeal and salt with 2 tbsp of the fat and 250ml boiling water. Shape into small ovals and fry in a cast iron pan until crisp. Eat warm with butter.

s.note: Flaky buttermilk biscuits with butter and golden syrup
s.how: Rub 100g cold butter into 300g flour with 3 tsp baking powder and salt. Stir in 250ml buttermilk, fold a few times and cut into rounds. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with butter and golden syrup.

m.note: Beef chuck, onion, carrots and potatoes cooked slowly until thick
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in a heavy pot. Add 2 onions, 3 carrots, 600g potatoes, 750ml stock and thyme. Put the lid on and cook over low coals or at 160C for 3 hours until thick.

w.note: Chewy ginger and cinnamon molasses cookies rolled in sugar
w.how: Beat 170g butter with 200g brown sugar, add 1 egg and 80ml molasses. Mix in 300g plain flour, 2 tsp bicarb soda, 2 tsp ginger and 1 tsp cinnamon. Roll into 24 balls, coat in caster sugar and bake at 180C for 10 minutes until cracked on top.

d.note: Bourbon, honey, lemon and hot water with cinnamon and cloves
d.how: Put 1 tbsp honey and the juice of a quarter lemon in each of 4 tin cups or mugs. Add 45ml bourbon to each, top with 150ml just-boiled water and stir. Drop in a cinnamon stick and a lemon wheel studded with 3 cloves. Make Mattie's version with hot apple juice in place of the bourbon and water.
